native_contracts.finding: Chosen root save is rolled before concatenated Spell1/Spell2 RunAction actions; sticky fallback; no two separate casts.
Reuses root save for MagicHack unless MakeSaveAlsoForMagicHack or no root SavingThrow; nested explicit saves are real exceptions.
Chosen school; AbilityData descriptors are the union of sources. Context and buff immunity descriptor domains must be checked separately.

Source selectors exclude level-zero/fused sources; ordinary selection swaps conflicting choices; slot level=max(native source levels), chosen source delivery, additional-area marker from other source.
Native metadata selection including delivery source preference: chain, non-SR and shape/range criteria; enumerate legal UI outputs rather than arbitrary geometry.
Live per-action cap; exported spellbook levels 1..6:5,7,10,15,20,100; not literal infinity. Energy drain has separate calculation.
Actual fused context is rooted at slot blueprint; constructor initializes ranks from CL; source RunAction reuse does not recreate both ordinary source contexts.
Native cone and line recipient/range predicates exist; binding and calling shape-correct read-only queries is feasible.

GetDeliverBlueprint(true) exposes optional area metadata. ProcessRoutine uses selected primary delivery and separately invokes source clicked-target actions with the existing context. AdditionalClicked.Apply uses MainTarget, which AbilityExecutionContext maps to ClickedTarget; this does not establish a second independently chosen aim or action payment. Application multiplicity/overlap must follow actual source actions.
Selects subsequent units relative to original clicked target; CheckTarget includes filters and can roll for Blinking, so must not execute it indiscriminately during forecasts.

Uses selected non-simple projectile OR AbilityTargetsAround on AbilityData.Blueprint, or actual BlueprintArea context. Replacing every holder-blueprint check with delivery would change the native swarm rule.
Delivery, AbilityData descriptors and context descriptors have distinct roles. Native context-based checks are not interchangeable with independent ordinary-source immunity checks.

limits: Headerless logs are not assigned a build by filename or chronology.
Same-named previous uploads had identical hashes; each current named input counted once.
No pooled cast/fight total across headerless or potentially overlapping sessions.
Command Success/acted is not proof that both payloads affected every intended target.
Static JBP export and stock BubblePrints data do not establish all runtime mod patches.
No new gameplay or performance improvement is claimed.

independent_review.name: Review of Magic Fusion plan.txt
independent_review.reviewer_reported_input_scope: truncated before native contracts and F4–F8

review_verified_native_contracts.finding: The inspected clicked-target path uses the same cast ClickedTarget/context; it does not ask for a second target or construct another command/payment.
Checks actual MetamagicData then CasterUnitPartSpecialMetamagic.GetMetamagic(ability). The actual cast object, rather than a fabricated custom blueprint, carries the relevant state.

review_dispositions.finding: Make shared numerical primitives/native-only orchestration boundary explicit; targeted regression parity with documented intentional common fixes.
Original F8 included support; add explicit F4S for qualified simple support mechanisms actually present, with subject/multiplicity/stacking.
Same native clicked target and cast context; no invented two-aim search, extra command or universal deduplication.
Geometry, ordering, allocation, dependency and execution multiplicity are separate capabilities. Correct footprint does not unlock HD/nested support.
Decision-local time-based marginal control coverage; shared existing facts/pending lifecycle, no persistent current-round certainty flag.
FusionDamageFactor already returns 1 for unrestricted non-HalfIfSaved damage, with existing native-shaped fixtures. MakeSaveAlsoForMagicHack governs explicit nested saving actions.
DamageMetamagic reads native AbilityData.HasMetamagic; count cap precedes dice result. Test actual allowed/active states without assuming manual slot UI support.

Some observer keys need configuration. Existing resistance exact-reference/epoch keys and cached identity strings are correct in their domains; proposed structural config omits other cast distinctions.
Produce field-use domain inventory. Some holder reads, including native swarm area rule, are intentional.
Hoist proven invariant raw amounts; save memo keyed by distinct node/DC/state; preserve viable/boss/safety/support candidates; diagnostic aggregates only.
All reasons already planned. Add blocker co-occurrence/sole-blocker counts, actual-player denominators and not-assessed states; no UI combat sweeps.
Observe natural in-game casts in both modes. Preparation can continue offline; gameplay acceptance remains unclaimed while unplayed.
No second Decide, unbounded table, extra rule/context/path work or parallel shadow AI.
Preserve outcomes for nonlinear utility; linear correlated expectations can be added. Ordinary recipient saves remain local; charge cast-level costs once.
